win_signatures.name: Higher-Timeframe Alignment & Confluent Liquidity Draw (A+ Setup)
confluence_criteria: Higher timeframe (1h/15m) Market Structure Shift (MSS/CHoCH) with aggressive displacement bodies.
Entry executed exclusively inside an unmitigated 15m Fair Value Gap (FVG) situated in deep Discount (>50% of displacement leg).
A distinct, untouched Buy-Side Liquidity (BSL) pool (e.g. Session Highs, Equal Highs) serves as the primary magnet target.
Full 15-minute candle acceptance (candle body closed affirming the shift; no open wicking triggers).
Risk-to-Reward ratio strictly >= 1:2.5, allowing a single win to easily absorb 3-5 capped losses.
win_signatures.execution_guideline: When all 5 criteria align during London/NY Killzones, allocate full standard margin ($10.00 / 24 contracts) with 3-tier TP bracket.

failure_signatures.name: Micro-Timeframe Front-Running of Terminal Liquidity (Anti-Pattern #1)
hazard_patterns: Premature entry on 1m/3m/5m sub-structure while higher timeframe (15m/1h) is in active downward displacement.
Front-running an unmitigated terminal liquidity pool (e.g., resting Asian Low, 24h Low, or Equal Lows within 150-250 points).
Attempting counter-trend catch without waiting for terminal SSL sweep.
Lack of full 15-minute candle close confirmation (entering on an active open candle).
failure_signatures.counter_measure: MANDATORY TERMINAL SHIELD: If price is within 250 points of major resting 24h liquidity, all counter-trend entry signals are strictly blocked until the liquidity pool is cleanly pierced AND a 15m candle closes back inside the range (ICT Turtle Soup / SFP).

failure_signatures.name: Bypassing Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation & Misinterpreting Status Inquiries as Execution Orders (Anti-Pattern #2)
hazard_patterns: Misinterpreting an informational user question ('are you start trading or not?') as an execution authorization command.
Subagents releasing internal technical clearances and automatically routing live orders to Delta Exchange without explicit user confirmation.
Trigger-happy execution bias during Killzone windows without user sign-off.
failure_signatures.counter_measure: MANDATORY HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP (HITL) HARD GATE: Under no circumstances may any order (market or limit) be transmitted to Delta Exchange without direct, explicit, written user trade authorization (e.g. 'Execute trade', 'Yes, place order'). Informational inquiries must strictly receive informational responses with zero automated order placement.
